verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a dedicated Balance product for real-time balance information. The docs say it is commonly used to check whether an account has sufficient funds before using it as a funding source for a payment, which is exactly the NSF pre-payment check in the story. A community comment independently confirms that real-time balance data is accessible through Plaid flows. Missing for 10: the specific balance endpoint name and its request/response details, any documentation of risk-scoring features beyond the raw balance, and hands-on corroboration that the balance is actually real-time.
